# Kipu Health

> Kipu Health is a comprehensive behavioral health EHR and practice management platform offering EMR, CRM, RCM, and GRC solutions tailored for addiction treatment, mental health, and eating disorder centers.

Kipu Health serves behavioral health providers with integrated software solutions designed to streamline clinical workflows, optimize revenue cycles, ensure compliance, and enhance patient engagement. The platform includes AI-powered documentation through Kipu Intelligence and specialized support for substance abuse treatment, medication-assisted treatment programs, and other specialized behavioral health settings.

## Key Topics

- Kipu EMR
- Behavioral Health EHR
- Electronic Medical Records
- Customer Relationship Management (CRM)
- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC)
- Kipu Intelligence
- Substance Abuse Treatment
- Clinical Workflows
- Patient Management

- Healthcare Compliance

- Care Coordination
